behaviors.description: Require a signature from the configured OCI lookaside before deployment.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent OCI app, trusted public key, installed native runtime, and monitored lookaside initially returning 404.
behaviors.expected: Missing signature rejects installation without changing deployments; publishing the trusted signature at the same URL permits execution of A.

behaviors.description: Reject an OCI lookaside signature made by an untrusted key.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent OCI image signed with a second disposable key absent from the remote trust store.
behaviors.expected: Untrusted signature rejects deployment; replacing only the signature with one from the trusted key permits execution of A.

behaviors.description: Reject a damaged OCI signature fetched from the configured lookaside.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent OCI app and a truncated trusted signed payload, with image and key unchanged.
behaviors.expected: Damaged signature rejects deployment; restoring the original signature permits execution of A.

behaviors.description: Replace the OCI lookaside URL on an existing remote.
behaviors.preconditions: Original lookaside has no signature; a second monitored URL already serves the independently trusted signature.
behaviors.expected: Installation fails before remote-modify, then fetches only the replacement lookaside and executes A with unchanged trust keys and registry image.

behaviors.description: Bind a trusted OCI signature to the exact image digest during update.
behaviors.preconditions: Signed A is installed; B is published with A's valid signature served at B's lookaside path.
behaviors.expected: Stale signed digest rejects update and preserves runnable A; replacing only the signature with a trusted signature for B permits execution of B.

mappings.rationale: Focused OCI trust contract without changing the requirement denominator.

surface_assertions.rationale: Recorded signature fetch, missing-signature rejection, unchanged deployments, and recovery after publishing a trusted signature at the configured URL.

mappings.rationale: Focused OCI key trust contract without changing the requirement denominator.

surface_assertions.rationale: Lookaside payload signed by an untrusted key is rejected; a trusted replacement alone permits the independent app.

mappings.rationale: Focused signed-payload integrity contract without changing the requirement denominator.

surface_assertions.rationale: Damaged lookaside payload is rejected and replacing only that payload with the original trusted signature permits the independent app.

mappings.rationale: Focused lookaside replacement contract without changing the requirement denominator.

surface_assertions.rationale: Changing only the lookaside URL changes rejected installation to trusted execution; monitored requests exclude the old URL after modification.

mappings.rationale: Focused signed-image identity contract without changing the requirement denominator.

surface_assertions.rationale: Signature for A at B's monitored lookaside path cannot authorize B; A survives and only a corrected signature permits execution of B.
